process_tree_cpu.scope: Each cell creates fresh workers. Per-process self user+system maxima deduplicated by pid/birth, plus exact collector rusage. Excludes children_user/system fields and does not double count ancestry. Sampled maxima miss unobserved processes/final tails and incomplete reads. Known lower bound takes the maximum of overlapping observed counters, never their sum. This is a lower bound, not exact total CPU, phase attribution, or a wall-time correction. Native outcomes and primary whole-time rule are unchanged.

scope: Diagnostic build of Fast/hybrid and product reuse; source-associated native verdict comparison required. Thread CPU stage counters exclude external LP-child CPU; pipeline denominator includes observed collector and waited-child CPU, not exhaustive external descendants. Ratios to known CPU lower bounds remain descriptive counter ratios, not exact complete-verification phase fractions. LP round-trip wall includes queue, IPC and external solve but overlaps concurrent source work, so these wall sums are not whole-wall fractions or an end-to-end speedup upper bound. Preprocessing includes numeric parse/type reasoning and restricted native linearization, not a separate ring/defeq/typeclass partition. Failed pre-probe/setup/control and work outside arithmetic remain unattributed.
